notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Sources: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000078003-25-000054) and 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0000078003-25-000062), read on EDGAR. LEADER: Bourla is a hired CEO. He beneficially owns 337,340 shares of common stock as of January 31, 2025 (including shares credited under the Pfizer Savings Plan and deferred shares from vested awards), which the proxy says is less than 1% of shares outstanding, so pctEconomic is null. A further 1,070,737 stock units, some settled in cash after separation, are shown in a separate column and are not counted as shares. HOLDERS: the proxy gives only the filing dates of the Schedule 13G/A reports behind the 5% holders (Vanguard February 13, 2024; BlackRock January 26, 2024; State Street January 29, 2024), not the as-of dates, so asOf is null; the figures are more than a year old. BUYBACKS: Pfizer bought back no stock in 2024 (dash in the cash-flow line; XBRL fact 0). No ESPP or broad-based grant program was recorded.
